run_performance_analysis_plot: run the CLI script to generate task and queue performance plots from a SQLite database
plot_task_stats: plot task statistics over time showing throughput, failures, and average execution time per stage
plot_queue_stats: plot queue statistics over time showing QPS, occupancy rate, and wait times per queue
add_gc_events_to_plot: add garbage collection events as hatched vertical spans to a matplotlib axes object
parse_args: parse command line arguments for db path, output directory, stage filter, time range, and plot settings
